purpose: The section 8 item 5 smoke of SAEA-E21-FULL44-TAIL2S-V1 (docs/readiness/2026-09-07-cross-carrier-silence-tail-v1-preregistration.md). Same model fragment, same baseline fragment, same serving geometry, same instruction, same decoding and the same obs_slice_tail_silence_seconds 2.0 as the full cell; the ONLY difference is the population, which is the single shortest discovery call instead of all 44. What it proves is the RUNTIME path -- that the tailed slice bytes the knob emits reach the resident server and that every emitted slice SHA-256 equals the committed @ts2 entry for that window. What it does NOT have to discover is whether the knob produces the right bytes at all: that is already proved offline on all 1,593 windows with zero contacts (tests/unit/test_obs_slice_tail_silence.py::test_the_knob_reproduces_every_committed_ts2_window_hash).
authorizes: nothing beyond its own pre-registered exposure row SAEA-E21-FULL44-TAIL2S-SMOKE-V1. No measurement, contrast, verdict or reported number may ever be computed on this call's outputs.

population.two_hashes_note: reproduction.probe_split carries TWO hashes: the receipt-integrity hash over the raw colon-convention item keys, and the run-identity hash under the E0 ledger convention (sha256 over LF-joined sorted <lock_key>/<sample_id>). split_identity_hash above is the RUN-identity hash, which is what the ExecutionPlan and the exposure-ledger column carry.
population.selection: no draw: the single shortest call of the frozen 44 by measured window count, deterministic and tie-broken by sample_id. Call 4386541 is already inside the sealed SAEA-E21-FULL44-DIRECT-BASELINE-V2 population, so no new speech surface is opened.
population.measured_not_assumed: Section 7 of the preregistration priced this smoke at 4 windows / 8 contacts / 400 audio seconds. NO call in the frozen 44 yields four fixed 90-second windows -- the shortest yields thirteen -- so the smoke's own exposure row registers the MEASURED figures (20 calls / 1,400 speech-audio seconds / 0.05 GPU hours) and records the correction. The GPU-hour ceiling section 7 set is unchanged and is not approached.

cells.factor: none against the full cell: this IS the full cell's protocol, restricted to one call
cells.serving_geometry: -c 36864 -np 6, 6,144 tokens per slot, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU, GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1

decision.rule: PASS iff every emitted slice SHA-256 equals the committed @ts2 entry for that window in docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-e21-buf90-1593-tail2s.json and every delivered clip is its sealed twin plus exactly 2.0 s. 13 of 13, or the full cell does not fly.
decision.claim_surface: none. A smoke roster carries no metric, no contrast and no verdict.
